user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account so that I can access my profile and manage my information. Acceptance Criteria: 1. I should be able to enter my email address in the input field with the placeholder 'Email Address' (selector: 'input[name="email"]'). 2. I should be able to enter my password in the input field with the placeholder 'Password' (selector: 'input[name="password"]'). 3. After clicking the 'Login' button (selector: 'button[type="submit"]:contains("Login")'), I should be redirected to my account page.
